source_passage: Alcohol retail (Dan Murphy's, BWS) and hospitality/gaming (ALH) with a real, recent customer-facing cyber event: a coordinated Jan 2024 credential-stuffing campaign hit Dan Murphy's accounts (among ~15,000 accounts across multiple AU retailers), enabling fraudulent purchases. Endeavour states its own systems were not compromised and no card data taken — so this is account-takeover/fraud exposure rather than a system breach, holding it at Medium. The FY2025 annual report names cyber as a key risk with a committed multi-year uplift program, signalling active risk awareness (and buying intent). Jan 2024 coordinated credential-stuffing campaign against Dan Murphy's accounts (reused creds from unrelated breaches); ~15,000 accounts across brands incl. THE ICONIC, Event Cinemas, Guzman y Gomez, TVSN, Binge; Endeavour systems not compromised, no card data taken Corroborating ACS Information Age coverage (campaign detected by Kasada), naming Dan Murphy's FY2025 annual report names data/privacy/cyber as a key risk; discloses multi-year cyber uplift program and a data-breach response plan with crisis exercises Former parent: Woolworths Group (demerged Jun 2021; Woolworths exited final 4.1% stake Sep 2024) Largest shareholder + ALH 25% JV partner: Bruce Mathieson Group / Bruce Mathieson Subsidiary/JV: Australian Leisure and Hospitality Group (ALH, 75% Endeavour) — ~350 hotels, ~12,000 pokies Owned brands: Dan Murphy's, BWS, Cellarmasters, Langton's, Jimmy Brings, Pinnacle Drinks, Paragon Wine Estates Auditor: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu (NOT PwC)
